sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN working_days_open - applicant_wait_days <= 3 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS within_promise_pct FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
explanation: The share of October 2026 decisions within the bank's 3-day promise.
